title: Testing
intro: Applies to: all tests, and to any behavioral change (which is incomplete without them).

entries.rule: `TEST-001` Tests **MUST** use PHPUnit with the `#[Test]` attribute. Every test that boots the application **MUST** extend the project's `Tests\TestCase`. Pest **MUST NOT** be used; a Pest-style `it(...)`/`test(...)` closure is a violation, not a preference.

checks.coverage: Flags a Pest-style it(...) or test(...) closure test, and a test method that lacks the #[Test] attribute.
Flags a test class that boots the application but does not extend Tests\TestCase; it exempts pure domain tests in the Unit suite that extend PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase.

entries.rule: `TEST-002` Tests of pure domain code (value objects, model methods with no query, rules on plain values) **SHOULD** live in a Unit suite and extend `PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase`, so they run without booting the framework or the database.
entries.why: they run without booting the framework or the database

entries.rule: `TEST-003` Test method names **MUST** be descriptive with the `it_` prefix, stating the behavior (`it_signs_up_a_member_successfully`, `it_returns_404_when_course_not_found`), never generic (`test_course`).

checks.coverage: Flags a #[Test] method whose name does not start with it_.

entries.rule: `TEST-005` Test data **MUST** come from factories and factory states; manual `Model::create([...])` where a factory state exists is a violation.

checks.coverage: Flags a Model::create(...) call inside a test class. It cannot tell whether a factory state exists for that model, so it over-flags.

entries.rule: `TEST-006` Tests **MAY** use facades and helpers freely. When invoking a job's `handle()` directly with injected dependencies, use `$this->app->call([$job, 'handle'])`.

entries.note: Filament/Livewire page-test rules (`Livewire::test`, `setCurrentPanel`, displayed-field assertions) are owned by `filament.md`.

entries.rule: `TEST-007` Every behavioral change **MUST** ship with tests covering the happy path, the failure paths, and the edge cases. An untested endpoint/handler/rule is incomplete work, not a follow-up.
`TEST-008` Controller happy-path tests **MUST** assert the full response structure (`assertJsonStructure` matching every resource key), not a spot-check.
`TEST-009` Every Form Request validation rule (`required`, `email`, `max`, `unique`, enum, `confirmed`, ...) **MUST** have a test that triggers it.
`TEST-010` Any test that creates, updates, or deletes data **MUST** assert the resulting database state, not just the HTTP response, using strict comparison (`assertSame`, never `assertEquals`).
applies_to: Any test that creates, updates, or deletes data

checks.coverage: Flags an assertEquals call in a test class. The rule covers database-state assertions in tests that change data, so it over-flags other assertEquals calls.

entries.rule: `TEST-011` A handler that dispatches a domain event **MUST** be tested with `Event::fake()` plus `assertDispatched(...)` including assertions on the event's properties.
applies_to: A handler that dispatches a domain event

entries.rule: `TEST-013` Every business-rule exception **MUST** have a test triggering it and asserting the HTTP status and message.
`TEST-014` Every authenticated endpoint **MUST** have a test asserting 401 when unauthenticated; every owned-resource endpoint **MUST** have a test asserting the failure when a non-owner tries it.
`TEST-015` State transitions **MUST** be tested from every relevant source state, not just the happy one.
`TEST-016` History/audit tests **MUST** assert the actual recorded content and metadata, not merely that a row exists.
